purpose: Deterministic coverage accounting for which canonically reviewed Shine applications can be observed through registered deployment sources.

states.meaning: A reviewed app has a registered full-app deployment source and at least one deployment observation.
A reviewed app has a registered full-app deployment source but no deployment observation yet.
Railway exposes only a repo-backed subservice that is not sufficient to represent the reviewed application deployment.
No trusted full-app deployment source or documented partial-service exception exists.

rules: Coverage is computed only for apps in the canonical reviewed ecosystem ledger.
A full-app source counts as observed only when at least one standard deployment observation exists for the same app.
Partial services never count as full deployment coverage.
Repository equality is required for both full-app sources and partial-service exceptions.
Coverage state is workflow metadata only and never changes certification, review, revocation or deployment state.
Coverage output is deterministic by app id.
nonClaims: Observed coverage does not mean the observed release is protected; deployment status is evaluated separately.
A partial service does not imply the parent app is undeployed.
Unmapped does not mean an app is unsafe or offline.
